_comment: Chapter 6 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F29, the third mirror shard (mirror_shards + 1: the mirror whole, ev_c6_mirror_whole).

text.zh_TW: 鏡廳的地上，最後一片碎鏡卡在石縫裡。你把它拔出來的時候，所有的鏡子同時亮了起來。
text.en: On the floor of the Mirror Hall, the last shard is wedged in a crack between the stones. As you pull it free, every mirror in the hall lights up at once.
